purpose: Release phantom StartIOKitMatching() kernelmanagerd busy count on gIOServiceRoot and publish gIOResourceIOKitKey on IOUserResources once PID 1 enters EL0 via ZornIokitDaemonQuiet301 (resolving Preferences.app SCNetworkInterfaceCopyAllWithPreferences / __wait_for_IOKit_to_quiesce 300s main-thread scroll freeze), reusing installed v297 root.

root_cause_analysis.symptom_reported_in_v277: Preferences.app opens and renders initial list, cannot scroll list on either CPU or GPU rendering, while bottom Home-bar swipe back to SpringBoard Home screen works normally.
root_cause_analysis.cross_device_reference: UniXNU-houji/archive/docs/display-performance.md:30-35 (Preferences main thread blocked in SCNetworkInterfaceCopyAllWithPreferences -> dispatch_once_wait -> configd InterfaceNamer __wait_for_IOKit_to_quiesce)
xnu_source_chain: libkern/c++/OSKext.cpp:1598-1634 — OSKext::driverkitEnabled() and OSKext::iokitDaemonAvailable() unconditionally return true on iOS (!XNU_TARGET_OS_WATCH).
iokit/Kernel/IOStartIOKit.cpp:187-196 — under !NO_KEXTD (verified linked via gIOMatchDeferList / iokitDaemonLaunched), StartIOKitMatching() calls IOService::getServiceRoot()->adjustBusy(+1).

iokit/Kernel/IOService.cpp:1229-1239 & 1654-1657 — adjustBusy(-1) and IOService::publishUserResource(gIOResourceIOKitKey) are deferred to IOService::iokitDaemonLaunched(), which is only invoked when userland kernelmanagerd calls into OSKext.

root-result295.json / root-result297.json — com.apple.kernelmanagerd.plist is absent in the monolithic-kernel LaunchDaemons set, leaving gIOServiceRoot busyState >= 1 for the entire 300s trial window.
root_cause_analysis.minimal_fix: ZornIokitDaemonQuiet301.h invoked once at PID 1 EL0 on verified K80 root: checks OSKext::iokitDaemonAvailable(), verifies IOUserResources lacks gIOResourceIOKitKey and gIOServiceRoot->getBusyState() > 0, then executes adjustBusy(-1) and publishUserResource(gIOResourceIOKitKey).
